body:
Namaste {{1}} team 🙏

Hum IV Infotech, Mehsana se hain. Aapke studio ko online dekhte hue humne ek baat notice ki: {{2}}.

Hum detailing studios ke liye ek simple booking page banate hain (packages, before-after work, reviews, WhatsApp booking message) aur Google profile ka upkeep bhi karte hain. Upar ka short video (lagbhag 1 minute) yahi dikhata hai.

Zyada jaanna chahenge? Neeche "Haan, bataiye" tap kijiye.
